qs.q:
Read the messages. What is the main idea of each message?
Match each message with one of the statements (A–F). There is one letter you do not need.
rights: E — You can count on me.

qs.q:
Where will Martin spend the weekend?

Email: "You know how I’ve been looking forward to working on my physics project at Peter’s place this weekend. Well, my mother says I promised to clear out my grandparents’ garage... and now I’m not allowed out."

Why is Lauren going to London?

Email: "I’m so excited I’m going to see my nephew, who’s only three months old. I hope I’ll have some time to see the sights too, because when I’m there at a conference, I usually don’t."
opts: To take part in a conference.
qs.note: Q7 — NCVVO je svim pristupnicima dodijelio bod zbog greške u ispitu (Odluka, 31. svibnja 2011.).

qs.q:
How much did Jack pay for the theatre ticket?

Email: "I finally got my theatre ticket for Giselle. The £6 seats were sold out, and the £10 seats seemed too expensive, so I decided to take one for £8."

What was Martha’s journey like?

Email: "Most people think trains are slow and boring, but I remember how thrilling my first train journey was. So I took the train to the seaside. Well, I had to stand the whole journey and my back was killing me."

Where did Jim take Coleen out?

Email: "I took Coleen out on our first date on Friday. I had booked a table at a nice Italian restaurant. I was late picking her up because I had to drop in at my cousin’s birthday party, so we ended up seeing a late show instead."

What is Martha Meyers’ nationality?

"My parents chose Canada. I grew up speaking French and kept telling people I was French." (Her father worked in Kent, England.)

How old is Martha Meyers?

"How does 25 years of French-Canadian upbringing influence your music?"

What is Martha Meyers’ profession?

"She’s just released the album Days of our Lives to stunning reviews."

What is Martha’s current hobby?

"My hobbies used to be rollerblading and water skiing. But, lately I’ve substituted water for snow."

What is Martha’s favourite instrument?

"My brothers and sisters and I play the violin, guitar, cello, flute, piano. But I always single out the keyboard instrument as my true love."

Complete the sentences with the correct endings (A–F). One letter is not needed.

16. Electricians have decorated some of the oldest trees in Britain with hundreds of lights ___.
17. The autumn colour trails regularly attract more than 100,000 daytime visitors, ___.
18. The arboretum, with 4,000 species, is one of the biggest in Europe ___.
19. Peter, the head forester, says that they chose specific trees ___.
20. He thinks we should just let nature do the talking, ___.
rights: A — whose branches create fantastic forms.
B — and is still growing in size.
C — to walk among the red and gold trees.
D — to create the first woodland electric light show.
E — because it’s really got a lot to say.
F — but the idea to light the trees at night came only recently.

Write a reply to Emma’s message. Answer ALL her questions. Write 40–60 words.

Emma’s message:
“In my last email I told you about my favourite TV programmes. What about you? How often do you watch TV? What is your favourite programme and why do you like it? What do you think about TV programmes for teenagers?”

You hear 5 phone messages. What is the main message of each speaker?
Match each message with one of the statements (A–F). One letter is not needed.
A woman is talking on the phone to a dental receptionist. What’s the woman’s name?
Lewis is talking to a friend about shopping. How much did Lewis pay for the jacket and trousers?
Two friends are planning their holiday. Where will they stay?
Alec is talking about next summer. Why is Alec going to work?
Leah is talking to a friend before school. Why hasn’t Leah got her homework?
opts: She didn’t have the time to do it.
